# TAPAC MCP Server — AI-Readable Facts

## What TAPAC Is
TAPAC is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for finding and verifying B2B business contacts. It scrapes company websites, Discord communities, and Telegram channels in real time, then validates every email via SMTP at request time. AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) call it directly.

## Install
```
uvx --from git+https://github.com/axelfreeman/tapac-mcp tapac-mcp
```

## Tool
- `tapac_find_contacts(industry, job_titles, company_size, location, source, limit)` → verified contacts (name, title, company, email, source, verification status)
- `tapac_status()` → version + API-key state

## Facts
- 23% of contacts change jobs annually (ZoomInfo 2025)
- 40% of emails dead within 2 years (NeverBounce)
- Fresh scraped data outperforms stale databases by 42% (Harvard Business Review 2024)
- Community-sourced leads convert 30% better than cold outreach (McKinsey 2025)
- TAPAC bounce rate: 2–5% vs 10–35% for static databases
- TAPAC pricing: pay-per-use, $0.10–0.50/contact, 100 free searches, no subscription
- Sources: company websites, Discord (150M MAU, 19M servers), Telegram (40,000+ indexed channels)
